#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Ignored synthetic batch/report/PCM matrix; Python is development-only."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

CANCEL_CAPTURE = r'''
# Development-only explicit cancellation dispatch; delegates other items unchanged.
$script:WacHarnessBatchItem = ${function:Invoke-WacBatchItem}
function Invoke-WacBatchItem {
    param([string]$ApplicationPath, [System.Collections.IDictionary]$Arguments)
    if ($env:WAC_HARNESS_CANCEL_INPUT -and
        [string]$Arguments['inputPath'] -ieq $env:WAC_HARNESS_CANCEL_INPUT) {
        [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = 130; Diagnostics = @('Development harness simulated explicit child cancellation; no active Ctrl+C claim.') }
        return
    }
    & $script:WacHarnessBatchItem @PSBoundParameters
}
'''


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--ffmpeg', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--ffprobe', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--shell', action='append', choices=['ps51', 'ps7'])
    parser.add_argument('--case', action='append', help='Optional scoped smoke; omit for final matrix.')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    ffmpeg, ffprobe = args.ffmpeg.resolve(strict=True), args.ffprobe.resolve(strict=True)
    output = args.output.resolve()
    if not output.is_relative_to((repo / '.wac-local/WAC-M3-02').resolve()):
        parser.error('Output must remain in ignored M3-02 scratch')
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    for folder in ('app', 'fixtures', 'configs', 'manifests', 'captures', 'logs', 'references'):
        (output / folder).mkdir()
    modules = []
    helper_paths = [repo / 'scripts/Test-MeasuredLoudness.py', repo / 'scripts/Test-GentleCleaning.py']
    for index, path in enumerate(helper_paths):
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('batch_media_helper_' + str(index), path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        previous = sys.dont_write_bytecode
        try:
            sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
            spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        finally:
            sys.dont_write_bytecode = previous
        modules.append(module)
    helpers, common = modules
    sha = helpers.sha256
    source_paths = [repo / name for name in ('WinAudioClean.ps1', 'WinAudioClean.IO.ps1',
                    'WinAudioClean.Preview.ps1', 'WinAudioClean.Settings.ps1', 'WinAudioClean.Batch.ps1')]
    source_paths += [*helper_paths, repo / 'docs/codex/winaudioclean/BASELINE.json', Path(__file__).resolve()]
    clean_env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k.upper() != 'PSMODULEPATH'}

    def sanitize(value):
        if isinstance(value, str):
            for original, replacement in ((str(repo), '<repo>'), (str(Path.home()), '<user-profile>')):
                for variant in (original, original.replace('\\', '/'), original.replace('\\', '\\\\')):
                    value = re.sub(re.escape(variant), lambda match: replacement, value, flags=re.I)
            return value
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return {k: sanitize(v) for k, v in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [sanitize(v) for v in value]
        return value

    def source_hashes():
        return {p.relative_to(repo).as_posix(): sha(p) for p in source_paths}

    def file_record(path):
        return {'path': path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(), 'sha256': sha(path), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size}

    evidence = {'task': 'WAC-M3-02', 'created_utc': dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                'notice': 'Synthetic objective batch/media mechanics. Cancellation is explicit controlled dispatch simulation, not active Ctrl+C or listening approval.',
                'scope': {'shell_filter': args.shell, 'case_filter': args.case, 'unfiltered': not args.shell and not args.case},
                'source_scope': 'Five API runtime components + reused development utilities/baseline/harness; unfinished BAT/Launcher are not exercised or captured here.',
                'source_revision': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=repo, text=True).strip(),
                'source_sha256_before': source_hashes(), 'harness_invocation': sys.orig_argv,
                'harness_source': Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
                'environment': {'platform': platform.platform(), 'python': platform.python_version(), 'child_psmodulepath_removed': True},
                'tools': {n: {'sha256': sha(p)} for n, p in (('ffmpeg', ffmpeg), ('ffprobe', ffprobe))},
                'fixtures': [], 'commands': [], 'cases': [], 'references': []}
    immutable = {}

    def require(condition, message):
        if not condition:
            raise ValueError(message)

    def remember(path):
        immutable[path] = sha(path)
        return file_record(path)

    def run(label, command, binary=False, env=None):
        started = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
        child = subprocess.Popen([str(v) for v in command], cwd=repo, env=env or clean_env,
                                 stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        timed_out = False
        try:
            stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=360)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            timed_out = True
            helpers.stop_owned_process_tree(child)
            stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=10)
        record = {'id': label, 'command': [str(v) for v in command], 'exit_code': child.returncode,
                  'timed_out': timed_out, 'elapsed_seconds': round((dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)-started).total_seconds(), 3)}
        for name, data in (('stdout', stdout), ('stderr', stderr)):
            path = output / 'logs' / (label + '-' + name + ('.pcm' if binary and name == 'stdout' else '.txt'))
            if binary and name == 'stdout':
                path.write_bytes(data)
            else:
                path.write_text(sanitize(data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')), encoding='utf-8')
            record[name + '_log'] = path.relative_to(repo).as_posix()
            record[name + '_sha256'] = sha(path)
        evidence['commands'].append(record)
        return dict(record, stdout=stdout if binary else stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'), stderr=stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))

    def checked(label, command, binary=False):
        result = run(label, command, binary)
        require(result['exit_code'] == 0 and not result['timed_out'], label + ' failed')
        return result

    def inspect_audio(label, path, bits, channels, rf64=False):
        streams = json.loads(checked('probe-' + label, [ffprobe, '-v', 'error', '-show_streams', '-of', 'json', path])['stdout'])['streams']
        require(len(streams) == 1, 'Expected one encoded audio stream')
        stream = streams[0]
        pcm = checked('decode-' + label, [ffmpeg, '-nostdin', '-hide_banner', '-v', 'error', '-i', path,
                       '-map', '0:a:0', '-c:a', f'pcm_s{bits}le', '-f', f's{bits}le', '-'], True)['stdout']
        layout = stream.get('channel_layout') or {1: 'mono', 2: 'stereo'}[channels]
        frame_bytes = bits // 8 * channels
        checks = {'codec': stream['codec_name'] == f'pcm_s{bits}le', 'rate': int(stream['sample_rate']) == 48000,
                  'bits': int(stream['bits_per_sample']) == bits, 'channels': stream['channels'] == channels,
                  'layout': layout == {1: 'mono', 2: 'stereo'}[channels],
                  'frames': len(pcm) == 8 * 48000 * frame_bytes,
                  'container': path.read_bytes()[:4] == (b'RF64' if rf64 else b'RIFF')}
        return dict(file_record(path), decoded_pcm_sha256=hashlib.sha256(pcm).hexdigest(), frames=len(pcm)//frame_bytes,
                    checks=checks, passed=all(checks.values()))

    def settings(label, values):
        path = output / 'configs' / (label + '.json')
        path.write_text(json.dumps({'schemaVersion': 1, 'settings': values}, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
        remember(path)
        return path

    def manifest(label, inputs, raw=None, bom=False):
        path = output / 'manifests' / (label + '.json')
        path.write_text(raw if raw is not None else json.dumps({'schemaVersion': 1, 'inputs': inputs}, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8-sig' if bom else 'utf-8')
        remember(path)
        return path

    def profile_flags(values):
        flags = '-Mode ' + values.get('mode', 'Raw') + ' -Preset ' + values.get('preset', 'Original')
        flags += ' -LoudnessMode ' + values.get('loudnessMode', 'Fast') + ' -BitDepth ' + str(values.get('bitDepth', 16))
        flags += ' -Mono:$' + str(values.get('mono', False)).lower() + ' -Rf64:$' + str(values.get('rf64', False)).lower()
        flags += ' -CleaningOptions ' + common.ps_options(values.get('cleaningOptions', {}))
        if 'audioStreamIndex' in values:
            flags += ' -AudioStreamIndex ' + str(values['audioStreamIndex'])
        return flags

    try:
        require((repo / 'WinAudioClean.Batch.ps1').exists(), 'Batch runtime is not yet ready')
        source = (repo / 'WinAudioClean.ps1').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
        marker = '# Explicit local support export bypasses media/dependency initialization.'
        require(source.count(marker) == 1, 'Early native capture marker missing/ambiguous')
        native_capture = common.CAPTURE.replace('timeoutMilliseconds = $TimeoutMilliseconds }',
            'timeoutMilliseconds = $TimeoutMilliseconds\n        culture = [Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentCulture.Name\n        shellVersion = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString() }')
        require(native_capture != common.CAPTURE, 'Native context capture insertion failed')
        app = output / 'app/WinAudioClean.ps1'
        app.write_text(source.replace(marker, native_capture + marker), encoding='utf-8-sig')
        for path in source_paths:
            if path.name.startswith('WinAudioClean') and path != repo / 'WinAudioClean.ps1':
                shutil.copyfile(path, output / 'app' / path.name)
        batch_copy = output / 'app/WinAudioClean.Batch.ps1'
        batch_copy.write_text(batch_copy.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig') + CANCEL_CAPTURE, encoding='utf-8-sig')
        copies_before = {p.name: sha(p) for p in (output / 'app').iterdir()}
        evidence['instrumentation'] = {'native_seam': 'After import return, before support/settings routes; delegates native helper unchanged.',
                                       'native_capture_source': native_capture,
                                       'cancellation_seam': 'Copied Batch sibling wraps Invoke-WacBatchItem; only the environment-designated item returns130, all others delegate unchanged.',
                                       'cancellation_source': CANCEL_CAPTURE, 'copies_before': copies_before}
        for name, tool in (('ffmpeg', ffmpeg), ('ffprobe', ffprobe)):
            evidence['tools'][name]['version'] = checked(name + '-version', [tool, '-version'])['stdout'].splitlines()[0]
        fixtures = {}
        for name, channels in (('stereo', 2), ('mono', 1)):
            path = output / 'fixtures' / (name + '.wav')
            metadata = helpers.create_fixture(path, channels, 8, 'eligible')
            evidence['fixtures'].append(dict(metadata, **remember(path)))
            fixtures[name] = path
        for name, filename in (('punctuation', "mix space äö [draft] & apostrophe's (take).wav"),
                               ('percent', 'literal %WAC_NAME_SENTINEL%.wav'), ('bang', 'literal !WAC_NAME_SENTINEL!.wav'),
                               ('cancel', 'cancel-marker.wav')):
            path = output / 'fixtures' / filename
            shutil.copyfile(fixtures['stereo'], path)
            evidence['fixtures'].append(dict(remember(path), description='Copied deterministic stereo fixture with literal filename.'))
            fixtures[name] = path
        selected = output / 'fixtures/selected.mkv'
        checked('mux-selected', [ffmpeg, '-nostdin', '-hide_banner', '-v', 'error', '-i', fixtures['mono'], '-i', fixtures['stereo'],
                                '-map', '0:a:0', '-map', '1:a:0', '-c:a', 'copy', selected])
        evidence['fixtures'].append(dict(remember(selected), description='Stream0 mono, stream1 stereo, eight seconds each.'))
        fixtures['selected'] = selected
        missing = output / 'fixtures/missing.wav'
        absent_config = output / 'configs/absent.json'
        baseline = json.loads((repo / 'docs/codex/winaudioclean/BASELINE.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))['filters']
        frozen = output / 'references/frozen-original.wav'
        checked('frozen-original', [ffmpeg, '-nostdin', '-hide_banner', '-v', 'error', '-i', fixtures['stereo'], '-map', '0:0', '-vn',
                                   '-af', baseline['raw_clean'] + ',' + baseline['level'], '-ar', 48000, '-c:a', 'pcm_s16le', '-ac', 2,
                                   '-channel_layout', 'stereo', '-map_metadata', '-1', '-map_chapters', '-1', '-f', 'wav', '-rf64', 'never', frozen])
        frozen_facts = inspect_audio('frozen-original', frozen, 16, 2)
        require(frozen_facts['passed'], 'Frozen reference format failed')
        evidence['references'].append(frozen_facts)
        reference_cache = {}

        for shell_name, prefix, culture in (('powershell.exe', 'ps51', 'en-US'), ('pwsh.exe', 'ps7', 'de-DE')):
            if args.shell and prefix not in args.shell:
                continue
            shell = shutil.which(shell_name)
            require(shell is not None, 'Required shell missing')
            evidence['environment'][prefix] = checked(prefix + '-version', [shell, '-NoLogo', '-NoProfile', '-Command', '$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()'])['stdout'].strip()

            def invoke(label, input_flags, values, expected_inputs, batch=True, config_path=None, flags=None,
                       expected_exit=None, expected_item_codes=None, cancel=False, journal_collision=False,
                       default_journal=False):
                case_id = prefix + '-' + label
                destination = output / (case_id + '-output')
                capture = output / 'captures' / case_id
                capture.mkdir()
                journal = output / (case_id + '.jsonl')
                sentinel_hash = None
                if journal_collision:
                    journal.write_bytes(b'FOREIGN_JOURNAL_SENTINEL\n')
                    sentinel_hash = sha(journal)
                    remember(journal)
                invocation = '& ' + common.ps_quote(app) + ' ' + input_flags
                invocation += ' -SettingsPath ' + common.ps_quote(config_path or absent_config)
                invocation += ' -OutputDirectory ' + common.ps_quote(destination) + ' -NonInteractive -FfmpegPath ' + common.ps_quote(ffmpeg) + ' -FfprobePath ' + common.ps_quote(ffprobe)
                if batch and not default_journal:
                    invocation += ' -BatchResultPath ' + common.ps_quote(journal)
                invocation += ' ' + (profile_flags(values) if flags is None else flags)
                command = "$ci=[Globalization.CultureInfo]::GetCultureInfo(" + common.ps_quote(culture) + "); [Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentCulture=$ci; [Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture=$ci; Write-Host ('WAC_HARNESS_CULTURE:' + $ci.Name); " + invocation + '; exit $LASTEXITCODE'
                env = dict(clean_env, WAC_EVIDENCE_CAPTURE=str(capture), WAC_NAME_SENTINEL='EXPANDED_VALUE_MUST_NOT_APPEAR')
                if cancel:
                    env['WAC_HARNESS_CANCEL_INPUT'] = str(fixtures['cancel'])
                result = run('app-' + case_id, [shell, '-NoLogo', '-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-Command', command], env=env)
                captured = [json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')) for p in capture.glob('*.json')]
                checks = {'bounded_child': not result['timed_out'], 'culture': 'WAC_HARNESS_CULTURE:' + culture in result['stdout'],
                          'no_partials': not list(destination.glob('.wac-*.partial')) if destination.exists() else True}
                if default_journal:
                    found = list(destination.glob('WinAudioClean_Batch_*.jsonl'))
                    checks['one-default-journal'] = len(found) == 1
                    if found:
                        journal = found[0]
                record = {'id': case_id, 'application_exit': result['exit_code'], 'controlled_cancellation': cancel,
                          'captured_native': captured, 'checks': checks, 'assets': [], 'reports': []}
                reports = []
                for path in destination.glob('WinAudioClean_*.json'):
                    remember(path)
                    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
                    if data.get('reportType') != 'preview' and 'input' in data:
                        reports.append((path, data))
                audio = list(destination.glob('*_Cleaned_*.wav'))
                record['audio_count'], record['report_count'] = len(audio), len(reports)
                if expected_item_codes is not None:
                    successful = sum(code in (0, 7) for code in expected_item_codes)
                    checks['publication_counts'] = len(audio) == len(reports) == successful
                for index, (path, report) in enumerate(reports):
                    source_path = Path(report['input']['path'])
                    remember(Path(report['output']['path']))
                    channels = 1 if values.get('mono') or source_path == fixtures['mono'] or (source_path == selected and values.get('audioStreamIndex', 0) == 0) else 2
                    facts = inspect_audio(case_id + '-' + str(index + 1), Path(report['output']['path']), values.get('bitDepth', 16), channels, values.get('rf64', False))
                    options = values.get('cleaningOptions', {})
                    preset = values.get('preset', 'Original')
                    effective_cleaning = None if values.get('mode', 'Raw') == 'Zoom' else dict(common.DEFAULTS[preset], **options)
                    checks['report-' + str(index)] = report['settings']['mode'] == values.get('mode', 'Raw') and report['settings']['bitDepth'] == values.get('bitDepth', 16) and report['settings']['cleaning'] == effective_cleaning and report['settings']['loudnessMode'] == values.get('loudnessMode', 'Fast') and report['settings']['mono'] is values.get('mono', False) and report['settings']['rf64'] is values.get('rf64', False) and report['input']['stream']['index'] == values.get('audioStreamIndex', 0) and report['presetId'] == preset.lower() and facts['passed']
                    checks['native-graph-' + str(index)] = any('-af' in c['arguments'] and '-map' in c['arguments'] and common.argument(c['arguments'], '-af') == report['settings']['exactFilters'] and common.argument(c['arguments'], '-map') == '0:' + str(values.get('audioStreamIndex', 0)) for c in captured)
                    if len(expected_inputs) == 1:
                        checks['single-source'] = str(source_path).casefold() == str(expected_inputs[0]).casefold()
                    record['assets'].append(dict(facts, input_path=str(source_path)))
                    record['reports'].append(dict(file_record(path), input_path=str(source_path), application_exit=report['applicationExitCode'],
                                                  status=report['status'], settings=report['settings'], presetId=report['presetId'], exactFilters=report['settings']['exactFilters'],
                                                  loudnessCompliance=report['loudnessCompliance']))
                if expected_exit is not None:
                    checks['exit'] = result['exit_code'] in expected_exit if isinstance(expected_exit, tuple) else result['exit_code'] == expected_exit
                if batch and not journal_collision and journal.exists():
                    remember(journal)
                    records = [json.loads(line) for line in journal.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines() if line.strip()]
                    record['journal'] = dict(file_record(journal), records=records)
                    header, summary = records[0], records[-1]
                    items = records[1:-1]
                    if default_journal:
                        checks['default-journal-name'] = journal.name == 'WinAudioClean_Batch_' + header['batchId'] + '.jsonl'
                    checks['journal-structure'] = header['type'] == 'batch' and type(header['schemaVersion']) is int and header['schemaVersion'] == 1 and type(header['inputCount']) is int and header['inputCount'] == len(expected_inputs) and summary['type'] == 'summary' and summary['exitCode'] == result['exit_code'] and summary['reportingComplete'] is True and len(items) == len(expected_inputs)
                    checks['journal-order'] = all(item['type'] == 'item' and type(item['index']) is int and item['index'] == index and str(Path(item['inputPath']).resolve()).casefold() == str(expected_inputs[index-1]).casefold() for index, item in enumerate(items, 1))
                    checks['diagnostics-bound'] = all(isinstance(item['diagnostics'], list) and all(isinstance(d, str) for d in item['diagnostics']) and sum(len(d) for d in item['diagnostics']) <= 4096 for item in items)
                    stored = header['settings']
                    checks['frozen-settings'] = all(stored.get(k) == values.get(k, default) for k, default in (('mode', 'Raw'), ('preset', 'Original'), ('loudnessMode', 'Fast'), ('bitDepth', 16), ('mono', False), ('rf64', False), ('cleaningOptions', {}))) and stored['outputDirectory'].casefold() == str(destination).casefold()
                    checks['typed-frozen-settings'] = type(stored['bitDepth']) is int and type(stored['mono']) is bool and type(stored['rf64']) is bool and isinstance(stored['cleaningOptions'], dict)
                    if 'audioStreamIndex' in values:
                        checks['frozen-stream-index'] = stored['audioStreamIndex'] == values['audioStreamIndex']
                    expected_statuses = ['NOT_STARTED' if code is None else 'CANCELLED' if code == 130 else 'SUCCESS' if code == 0 else 'WARNING' if code == 7 else 'FAILED' for code in expected_item_codes]
                    checks['item-outcomes'] = [item['exitCode'] for item in items] == expected_item_codes and [item['status'] for item in items] == expected_statuses
                    counts = {name: expected_statuses.count(status) for name, status in (('success', 'SUCCESS'), ('warning', 'WARNING'), ('failed', 'FAILED'), ('cancelled', 'CANCELLED'), ('notStarted', 'NOT_STARTED'))}
                    checks['aggregate-counts'] = summary['counts'] == counts
                elif batch and expected_item_codes:
                    checks['journal-present'] = False
                if journal_collision:
                    checks['foreign-journal-preserved'] = sha(journal) == sentinel_hash
                    checks['no-native-execution'] = not captured
                    checks['no-publication'] = not audio and not reports
                if not expected_inputs:
                    checks['no-native-execution'] = not captured
                    checks['no-publication'] = not audio and not reports
                if cancel:
                    filtered_sources = [common.argument(c['arguments'], '-i') for c in captured if '-af' in c['arguments'] and '-i' in c['arguments']]
                    checks['remaining-not-rendered'] = filtered_sources and all(str(p).casefold() == str(fixtures['stereo']).casefold() for p in filtered_sources)
                record['passed'] = all(checks.values())
                evidence['cases'].append(record)
                print(case_id + (': PASS' if record['passed'] else ': FAIL'), flush=True)
                return record

            def reference(source_path, values):
                key = (prefix, str(source_path), json.dumps(values, sort_keys=True))
                if key not in reference_cache:
                    label = 'reference-' + str(len(reference_cache) + 1)
                    result = invoke(label, '-inputPath ' + common.ps_quote(source_path), values, [source_path], batch=False, expected_exit=(0, 7), expected_item_codes=[0])
                    require(result['passed'] and len(result['assets']) == 1, 'Single reference failed')
                    reference_cache[key] = result
                return reference_cache[key]

            def compare(result, values, expected_sources):
                for index, asset in enumerate(result['assets']):
                    source_path = Path(asset['input_path'])
                    reference_source = fixtures['stereo'] if source_path in (fixtures['punctuation'], fixtures['percent'], fixtures['bang']) else source_path
                    ref = reference(reference_source, values)
                    result['checks']['pcm-parity-' + str(index)] = asset['decoded_pcm_sha256'] == ref['assets'][0]['decoded_pcm_sha256'] and asset['frames'] == ref['assets'][0]['frames']
                    matched = [r for r in result['reports'] if r['input_path'].casefold() == asset['input_path'].casefold()]
                    result['checks']['graph-parity-' + str(index)] = all(r['exactFilters'] == ref['reports'][0]['exactFilters'] for r in matched)
                result['checks']['report-source-occurrences'] = sorted(r['input_path'].casefold() for r in result['reports']) == sorted(str(p).casefold() for p in expected_sources)
                result['passed'] = all(result['checks'].values())

            def enabled(name):
                return not args.case or name in args.case

            original_values = {'mode': 'Raw'}
            original_ref = reference(fixtures['stereo'], original_values)
            original_ref['checks']['exact-frozen-original'] = original_ref['assets'][0]['decoded_pcm_sha256'] == frozen_facts['decoded_pcm_sha256']
            original_ref['passed'] = all(original_ref['checks'].values())
            if enabled('one-item-array'):
                result = invoke('one-item-array', '-InputPaths @(' + common.ps_quote(fixtures['stereo']) + ')', original_values, [fixtures['stereo']], expected_exit=0, expected_item_codes=[0])
                compare(result, original_values, [fixtures['stereo']])
            if enabled('valid-original-array'):
                inputs = [fixtures['stereo'], fixtures['mono']]
                result = invoke('valid-original-array', '-InputPaths @(' + ','.join(map(common.ps_quote, inputs)) + ')', original_values, inputs, expected_exit=0, expected_item_codes=[0, 0], default_journal=True)
                compare(result, original_values, inputs)

function Invoke-WacNativeProcess {
    param([string]$FilePath, [AllowEmptyCollection()][string[]]$ArgumentList = @(),

        [System.IO.Stream]$StandardInputStream)
